lines.x: How long are you gonna sit there, Doctor? Don't you want to go out and play? Work? Where's the fun in that? Come on, put this stuff down and let's go have some fun!

Mitsukue is a special place! There's plenty of good food and fun to be had, handsome boys and beautiful girls everywhere you look. And the best part? Anything you want, you can find it there—as long as you're not concerned about authenticity!
This one, and this... that should be enough... oh, hi, Doctor! I'm putting new stickers on my gun, and I've got some left over. Anything you want to sticker up? I can spare a few.
Final lap! Come on, come on! Faster, faster—argh, allllmost... Hm? No, I didn't bet. Spent all my money at the beginning of the month. I'm just watching the stream for the thrill of it.

This place is just the right length and width, and hardly anyone ever comes by... Get yelled at? A tongue-lashing is no big deal! Okay. One phone call, and we'll have a pachinko machine here tomorrow!

My gran's first lesson for me was that the truth doesn't matter, and the means don't matter either. The fake gems she appraised would end up on fancy ladies, bought for eye-popping money. And our fake guns protect the Lucky Star just fine.

One Lucky Star's enough trouble; I can't imagine what it takes to run a whole Rhodes Island... Huh? The people I picked up? They... weren't any trouble; just gave them some medicine and let them lie down…

Oh no, look at this! There's another new idol in Mitsukue! Momoka's fan club has already lost a bunch of members... Me? Of course I'm staying true! I'm her most loyal fan, even if I don't have the money to buy any merch. My love for Momoka is true!

Towers built from bubbles teeter, and everyone goes grasping for a star in their final moments... my star appeared when I was on the verge of freezing to death, the night I was abandoned by my parents as an infant. She gave me a home.
Huh? The Dr.{@nickname}'s not in the office today… Guess I'll have to find somebody else... who should I pick? Can't be a complainer, a miser, or sane enough to keep clear…

Kichisei the Unerring, reporting in! Come to the Lucky Star in Mitsukue for all your needs, whether you need a gem appraiser, a fence, or an information broker. I am always at your service during business hours.
Real guns... they use them differently from gran…
Wow, working for you lot pays so much better than the yakuza.
Rest assured. You're always VIPs at the Lucky Star.
Breaktime's…. over, I guess.
I'm the leader? Alright, better to work for you than to stick my neck out for someone else.
Come with me, I know a secret passage.
Mm, just as I thought.
Hm? What's that?
Yeah, yeah, heard you the first time...
Loaded... check.
Something suspicious up ahead, two hundred meters.
The gun may be fake, but yeah, that's all it takes.
I don't need to aim!
Hope you enjoy this!
Unerring!
*laughter* Well done! Did anyone get a pic of that? I want to print it out and put it up on the door of the Lucky Star!
Good job! Dismissed. Go do whatever you want, and see you next time!
I guess we're done. Can I hit the pachi… Err, can I take a game break now?
Whoa, whoa, we pissed off the wrong guy! Run! Move those legs! Let's get out of here!
This is a nice little space. Maybe I can get a few arcade cabinets set up... no, you didn't hear me say anything.
Hey! Take it easy... I'm not a broken vending machine you can fix with a smack, you know!
Wooo... Good timing. I was about to sneak out for a drink... wanna join me?
Arknights.
The Lucky Star's open all night today! Not that there are many guests at this hour, but it's one of grandma's old sayings. When the Lucky Star stays open, good fortune comes often.
Irrashaimase... oops, I guess I let the old habits slip in. What brings you here, Doctor?
Hey, Doctor, wanna know the plan for your birthday party? For this low, low price, I'll tell you what surprise Amiya has in store for you, and what 'surprise' Elysium has…
After today is tomorrow. After tomorrow another tomorrow—come find me again tomorrow, Doctor.
